Aditi Lakshmi Satish

PhD Research Scholar · HoMeCell Lab, IIT Gandhinagar

“Resource optimisation through transcription start site selection and its exploitation in cancers.”

I investigate how human cells deploy alternative transcription start sites (TSS) to balance cellular metabolic investment against transcriptional yield. By interrogating stochastic versus adaptive transcriptional trajectories, my work uncovers how deregulated start site initiation drives futile transcriptional expenditure in tumors.

Recent Accepted Work

Featured Publication

Accepted Paper · 2026

Gene functions determine stochastic or adaptive futile transcription in cancers through deregulated start site deployments

Journal: Frontiers in Bioinformatics
DOI: 10.3389/fbinf.2026.1883461 ↗
Author: Aditi Lakshmi Satish et al.

While transcription start site (TSS) selection governs transcriptional fidelity in eukaryotes, malignant cells frequently exhibit profound deregulation in initiation site architecture. This study establishes that intrinsic gene functional classifications modulate whether initiation shifts represent stochastic transcriptional noise or adaptive metabolic survival strategies. By quantifying the thermodynamic and molecular penalties of futile transcription, we elucidate how deregulated TSS usage shapes cancer cell plasticity.

Core Inquiries

Research Architecture

Three foundational inquiries guiding computational and molecular analysis at the intersection of transcription energetics and oncogenesis.

01

Resource Optimisation & Energetic Costs

Transcription is one of the most ATP-intensive biosynthetic operations in eukaryotic cells. We quantify the economy of transcription initiation.

02

Stochastic vs. Adaptive Behavior

Differentiating random transcriptional drift from evolutionary adaptation. We analyze whether aberrant start site selections constitute purposeless biochemical overflow (futile cycles) or advantageous phenotypic diversification.

03

Gene Functions & Cancer Hallmarks

Investigating how intrinsic gene functional classifications modulate whether start site shifts represent stochastic noise or drive adaptive cancer hallmarks, dictating cellular survival and metabolic resilience in tumors.
